# Requirements: refining the product obligations

The system requirements establish broad obligations. This chapter refines them into capabilities that can be implemented and quality constraints that shape how those capabilities must behave.

## Functional requirements

::: {.need #FUN-001 type="functional-requirement" status="approved" priority="critical" tags="parser;authoring;graph" derives-from="SYS-001" implemented-by="COMP-PARSER;IF-001" verified-by="TC-007"}
## Parse engineering declarations from Quarto source

Quarto-Needs shall parse `.need` declarations from QMD sources into structured engineering object declarations with stable identity and source locations.

### Rationale

Text-first authoring is only useful if the semantic core can recover structured objects deterministically from ordinary documentation sources.
:::

::: {.need #FUN-002 type="functional-requirement" status="approved" priority="critical" tags="relations;semantics;graph" derives-from="SYS-001" implemented-by="COMP-ANALYSIS" verified-by="TC-008"}
## Resolve authored relations through a canonical relation catalog

Quarto-Needs shall resolve authored relation names into canonical semantic families, endpoint roles, impact direction, and traversal direction.

### Rationale

Presentation layers and downstream analysis must consume one authoritative meaning for every engineering relation.
:::

::: {.need #FUN-003 type="functional-requirement" status="approved" priority="high" tags="query;graph;views" derives-from="SYS-001;SYS-006" implemented-by="COMP-ANALYSIS;COMP-GRAPH" verified-by="TC-009"}
## Materialize named queries as reusable graph views

Quarto-Needs shall evaluate named queries in the Python core and materialize bounded graph projections that can be reused by documentation views.

### Rationale

Complex selection belongs in the semantic core rather than being reimplemented independently in Lua or JavaScript.
:::

::: {.need #FUN-004 type="functional-requirement" status="approved" priority="high" tags="graph;cytoscape;exploration" derives-from="SYS-002;SYS-006" implemented-by="COMP-GRAPH" verified-by="TC-010"}
## Explore traceability interactively using semantic graph controls

The HTML graph shall support semantic parent/child exploration, traversal profiles, type/status/family filtering, path-to-root analysis, edge inspection, collapse/expand, and adjustable spacing.

### Rationale

A traceability graph becomes significantly more useful when engineers can investigate relationships rather than only view a static topology.
:::

::: {.need #FUN-005 type="functional-requirement" status="approved" priority="high" tags="baseline;diff;impact;governance" derives-from="SYS-003" implemented-by="COMP-BASELINE" verified-by="TC-011"}
## Compare engineering states through baseline, diff, and impact analysis

Quarto-Needs shall persist engineering baselines and compare them with current snapshots to identify content, relocation, relation, and impact changes.

### Rationale

Version history becomes engineering information when changes can be interpreted in terms of the typed traceability graph.
:::

::: {.need #FUN-006 type="functional-requirement" status="approved" priority="high" tags="localization;i18n;validation" derives-from="SYS-005" implemented-by="COMP-I18N" verified-by="TC-005" mitigates="RISK-004"}
## Validate semantic parity of localized sources

Quarto-Needs shall reject localized QMD siblings that alter engineering IDs, types, statuses, attributes, or relations relative to the canonical source.

### Rationale

Translation should change presentation, not create a second engineering model.
:::

::: {.need #FUN-007 type="functional-requirement" status="approved" priority="medium" tags="quarto;extension;distribution" derives-from="SYS-002" implemented-by="COMP-EXTENSION" verified-by="TC-012"}
## Synchronize canonical extension assets into rendered examples

The example pre-render workflow shall copy the canonical Quarto extension assets into the staged project before analysis and rendering.

### Rationale

Examples should exercise the extension that is actually under development rather than drift through hand-maintained copies.
:::

::: {.need #FUN-008 type="functional-requirement" status="approved" priority="high" tags="graph;provenance;security" derives-from="SYS-006" implemented-by="COMP-GRAPH;IF-003" verified-by="TC-006"}
## Publish safe declaration provenance for graph inspection

Public graph projections shall expose only presentation-safe relative source provenance needed to explain where an engineering relation was declared.

### Rationale

Explainability benefits from `file:line` provenance, but public projections must not leak absolute paths or arbitrary source content.
:::

::: {.need #FUN-009 type="functional-requirement" status="approved" priority="medium" tags="quarto;toc;sidebar;usability;progressive-enhancement" derives-from="SYS-002" implemented-by="COMP-EXTENSION" verified-by="TC-014"}
## Collapse the page margin TOC without obscuring navigation

The HTML extension shall provide an optional persistent control that collapses and restores the page margin table of contents, reclaims content width while collapsed, and positions the expanded-state control entirely outside the TOC so it does not obscure the title or navigation items.

### Rationale

A collapsible margin TOC is only useful if the control itself does not interfere with the navigation surface it manages.
:::

## Non-functional requirements

::: {.need #NFR-001 type="non-functional-requirement" status="approved" priority="critical" tags="determinism;reproducibility;governance" derives-from="SYS-003" implemented-by="COMP-ANALYSIS;COMP-BASELINE" verified-by="TC-013"}
## Produce deterministic engineering outputs

Equivalent project states shall produce stable snapshots, fingerprints, projections, and comparison results independent of incidental traversal order.

### Rationale

Determinism is required for trustworthy CI, baseline comparison, and code review.
:::

::: {.need #NFR-002 type="non-functional-requirement" status="approved" priority="critical" tags="security;privacy;graph" derives-from="SYS-006" implemented-by="COMP-GRAPH" verified-by="TC-006" mitigates="RISK-002"}
## Keep public projections deny-by-default

Public graph output shall expose only explicitly approved fields and safe provenance metadata.

### Rationale

Interactive documentation must not become an accidental export channel for internal engineering data.
:::

::: {.need #NFR-003 type="non-functional-requirement" status="approved" priority="high" tags="accessibility;progressive-enhancement;quarto" derives-from="SYS-002" implemented-by="COMP-EXTENSION" verified-by="TC-002"}
## Preserve a static equivalent for interactive views

Every interactive graph shall be backed by a static representation and accessible tabular traceability derived from the same projection.

### Rationale

Interactivity must enhance the document rather than become the only way to access engineering information.
:::

::: {.need #NFR-004 type="non-functional-requirement" status="approved" priority="high" tags="graph;performance;limits" derives-from="SYS-006" implemented-by="COMP-GRAPH" verified-by="TC-006" mitigates="RISK-003"}
## Bound graph publication by explicit budgets

Graph views shall enforce configurable maximum node and edge counts rather than silently publishing or truncating unbounded results.

### Rationale

Large graphs can harm rendering, usability, and reviewability; failure should be explicit and reproducible.
:::

::: {.need #NFR-005 type="non-functional-requirement" status="approved" priority="critical" tags="semantics;architecture;graph" derives-from="SYS-001;SYS-003" implemented-by="COMP-ANALYSIS" verified-by="TC-001" mitigates="RISK-001"}
## Resolve engineering semantics in the core only

Engineering meaning shall be resolved by the Python core; Lua and browser clients shall consume semantic projections and shall not redefine relation meaning.

### Rationale

Duplicated semantic maps create drift and make equivalent views disagree about the same engineering graph.
:::
